About me

Who I Am

I'm a Computer Science postgraduate student at Tikaram Jagannath College, Pune, with a solid background in Python, SQL, web development, and data visualisation tools like Power BI and Tableau. I enjoy turning raw data into clear, actionable insights through analytical dashboards and well-structured database models.

Through internships at Cognifyz Technologies (Power BI) and CodSoft IT Services (Data Science), I've built production-level dashboards and executed complete ML pipelines — from raw data to model evaluation and stakeholder-ready reporting.

My current focus is growing as a Data Analyst while building the core technical skills — databases, pipelines, and system design — to transition into Data Engineering. I'm actively seeking entry-level Data Analyst roles where I can add real value from day one.

"I believe data storytelling is just as important as data analysis — insights mean nothing if they can't be communicated clearly."
